title: 番外II 紫虚异域日记VII 蛙类必须死
content_zh:
毒箭蛙靠着惊人的动态视力，轻松的捕捉到了高速移动的紫虚，然后弹出它那可怕的舌头，像是小青蛙黏住苍蝇一样黏住了紫虚，然后以超过十倍音速的速度收缩了回来。
毒箭蛙的嘴巴张的老大，瞬间将舌头收了回来，然后像是吃到了什么美味一样嚼了起来，不过连着嚼了几口，并没有尝到什么味道，顿时有点犯傻一样的左右甩头。
由于本身纯粹动态视力的问题，毒箭蛙完全没有看到眼前不到百米处那团缓缓移动的黑雾，嗯，那就是已经毒化了的紫虚，仙人就这点好，不抹杀了神，身体随时可以化作内气。
被毒箭蛙弹出来的舌头玩了捆绑，瞬间以十倍音速缩回差点再次被喂蛙的紫虚，在零点零几秒的时间内炸成了毒雾躲过了一劫。
不过紫虚可不知道毒箭蛙的视力是动态视力，现在炸成一片毒雾的紫虚正在想办法逃离这里，现在这个状态，他完全不是毒箭蛙的对手，就算是用毒，也需要他将这些毒属性内气变成自己的。
“呱呱呱！”毒箭蛙毕竟是吃了神石，算是有灵性的怪物，吃没吃到紫虚他还是清楚的，在确定被玩了之后大怒着叫了起来。
“咕噜呱！”随着毒箭蛙身体内部爆发出一声沉闷的声音，原本的毒箭蛙骤然膨胀了一圈，而四周的空气甚至如同大风朝着毒箭蛙的嘴里涌去，而紫虚化作的毒雾，也被狂风吹了过去。
毒箭蛙瞬间膨胀了数倍，而紫虚化作的毒雾差点被吸进了嘴里，吓得紫虚赶紧恢复了原型，然后朝着天上飞去，而早有准备的毒箭蛙，在看到紫虚的瞬间，就朝着紫虚的方向跃去，舌头也朝着紫虚弹射而去，而长大的嘴巴，随时准备将紫虚吸到嘴里。
超高速的舌头成功命中了紫虚，紫虚再次化作毒雾，而毒箭蛙的深呼吸直接将紫虚化作的毒雾吸到了嘴里，然后毒箭蛙直接闭嘴栽到雨林趴在那里一动不动。
在毒箭蛙嘴里恢复原型，勉强靠着内气抵抗毒箭蛙毒气消化的紫虚脸黑的跟非洲人没啥区别，当然紫虚没见过非洲人，但他见过张飞，不过这都不重要，重要的是武力被克制也就罢了，他的智力居然未能击败毒箭蛙的本能？！
强行顶住毒箭蛙毒气的消化，紫虚开始炼化自己的内气，黑人就黑人吧，反正现在不能死，没见到贾诩之前绝对不能死。
毒箭蛙奋力的消化着紫虚，整只娃趴在地上就跟冬眠一样一动不动，而时不时增强的气息，让毒箭蛙很爽，果然吃蛇什么的，那里有吃这种不知道是什么玩意的东西好，这种虫子营养丰富。
经过数个时辰的努力，紫虚被毒箭蛙炼化掉了十分之一的内气，但是他自己也掌握了五成躯体之中的内气，不过再继续下去就有些得不偿失，于是紫虚飞在毒箭蛙体内开始寻找，最后终于找到了生路。
毒箭蛙的上颚有两个孔，虽说不大，而且在努力紧闭，但是紫虚知道这是他的生路，当即将积蓄起来的所有力量，随后紫黑色的内气骤然爆发。
虽说因为毒属性内气来源完全相同，被同化的厉害，但是依旧成功将打出了一个半米大的洞，紫虚当即从那里飞了出去。
而一直闭目养神的毒箭蛙，随着这一击，原本只是装饰的外鼻孔直接被轰出来一个半米大的鼻孔，毒箭蛙当即一声惨叫，随后就像是疯了一样朝着天上的紫虚追去。
上颚的大洞传来的疼痛，让毒箭蛙本身就不大的脑子里面写满了对于紫虚的愤怒，直接将之定位头号食物，不管不顾的朝着紫虚追去，甚至于原本根本不会的飞行，靠着在空中疯狂连续跳跃，也能做到不亚于紫虚的超高速度。
紫虚疯狂的飞，他现在的状态可有些不妙，甚至有些接近于传说之中的鬼仙，身体都有些透明，至于攻击毒箭蛙，他现在根本无法做到，他的内气对于毒箭蛙的伤害几乎是零。
如果常规状态那一击早就将毒箭蛙打成碎片，而现在只是打出一个不致命的洞，所以还是赶紧跑吧！
还好自从离开中原之后，紫虚积攒下来大量的被追杀经验，拥有应对各种被追杀的常识，所以紫虚成功的维持着被追杀的局面，没有被毒箭蛙吃掉。

至于从毒箭蛙那里逃掉，开什么玩笑，毒箭蛙的动态视力早已经注定了紫虚完全没希望逃掉。
不管紫虚一路上使出什么手段都没有意义，嗯，其实是有意义的，紫虚一路上不断使用的反追杀经验，成功让毒箭蛙和他的距离靠近了很多，估计再来几次，紫虚就进入毒箭蛙舌头的攻击距离了。
所以紫虚也就停止了作死，可劲的飞，一路疯狂的往北飞，从南极飞到南美洲，紫虚还没休息就一路狂飞到北美洲，直到紫虚看到了某个金字塔之后这件事终于告一段落了。
那一刻紫虚差点吓死了，在他飞过金字塔的时候，没有发生什么，但是在毒箭蛙飞过金字塔的时候，一条蛇头长着翅膀的超级大蛇，看那大小恐怕有个千多米，直径都有几十米，然后……
嗯，没有然后了，那条超级蛇，嘴巴张开都有个几十米大，一口将这只能飞的呱都咬住，毒箭蛙拼命躲过了大半的伤害，然后毒血毒内气炸了一片。
至于为什么拼命逃跑的紫虚回头看了一眼就知道毒箭蛙躲过了大半的伤害，其实很简单，那条羽蛇只咬中一半，毒箭蛙成功保留了半片身子，现在这倒霉的成天吃蛇的蛙变成了半只青蛙……
不过羽蛇，或者说是羽蛇神也没好过，毒箭蛙的剧毒被羽蛇神吞下，千米长的羽蛇神当即就被麻痹的上半身不稳砸到金字塔上，差点上半身被折断，而受创的毒箭蛙眼见常年的食物都敢攻击自己，而且要掉了自己半个身子，当即舍了紫虚，一口咬向羽蛇神。
羽蛇神一口下去，吃到了多年以来最难吃的蛙，不过作为一条蛇，就算是羽蛇，就算升级到羽蛇神的高度，那只要是青蛙就必须吃掉，管他有毒没毒，必须吃掉，蛇类必须要是蛙类的天敌啊！
content_en:
The poison dart frog relied on its amazing dynamic vision to easily capture the high-speed moving Zi Xu, then popped out its terrifying tongue and stuck to Zi Xu like a small frog sticking to a fly, and then shrank back at a speed exceeding ten times the speed of sound.
The poison dart frog's mouth opened wide, and he retracted his tongue in an instant, and then chewed it as if he had eaten something delicious. However, after chewing a few mouthfuls, he didn't taste anything, and he suddenly shook his head from side to side like a fool.
Due to its purely dynamic vision problem, the poison dart frog completely failed to see the slowly moving black mist less than a hundred meters in front of it. Well, that was the poisoned Zixu. This is the good thing about immortals. If you don't kill the god, your body can turn into inner energy at any time.
Zi Xu, who was tied up by the tongue that popped out from the poison dart frog, instantly retracted at ten times the speed of sound and was almost fed to the frog again. It exploded into poisonous mist in a few tenths of a second and escaped disaster.
However, Zixu doesn't know that the poisonous arrow frog's vision is dynamic vision. Now Zixu, who has exploded into a poisonous mist, is trying to find a way to escape from here. In this state, he is no match for the poisonous arrow frog. Even if he uses poison, he still needs to turn the poisonous energy into his own.
"Quack, quack, quack!" After all, the Poison Dart Frog was considered a spiritual monster after eating the sacred stone. He still knew whether it had eaten Zixu or not. After confirming that it had been played, he screamed angrily.
"Gulugua!" As a dull sound erupted from the poison dart frog's body, the original poison dart frog suddenly expanded in a circle, and the surrounding air even rushed towards the poison dart frog's mouth like a strong wind, and the poisonous mist transformed by Zixu was also blown away by the strong wind.
The poison dart frog expanded several times in an instant, and the poisonous mist transformed by Zixu was almost sucked into his mouth. Zixu was so frightened that Zixu quickly restored his original shape, and then flew towards the sky. The poison dart frog, which had been prepared for a long time, jumped in the direction of Zixu the moment it saw Zixu, and its tongue also shot towards Zixu. Its big mouth was ready to suck Zixu into his mouth at any time.
The super-speed tongue successfully hit Zixu, who turned into poisonous mist again. The poisonous dart frog's deep breath directly sucked the poisonous mist turned by Zixu into its mouth. Then the poisonous dart frog shut up and fell into the rain forest, lying there motionless.
The original shape of Zi Xu was restored in the mouth of the poison dart frog. Zixu, who barely relied on his internal energy to resist the poisonous gas digestion of the poison dart frog, had a dark face that was no different from that of an African. Of course, Zi Xu had never seen an African, but he had seen Zhang Fei, but this was not important. What was important was that the force was restrained. His intelligence failed to defeat the instinct of the poison dart frog? !
Forcibly resisting the digestion of the poisonous dart frog's gas, Zixu began to refine his inner energy. Black people will be black people. Anyway, he can't die now, and he will never die before seeing Jia Xu.
The poison dart frog worked hard to digest Zixu. The whole baby lay on the ground motionless as if hibernating. The aura that intensified from time to time made the poison dart frog feel good. Sure enough, it really eats snakes or something. There are good things to eat like this. This kind of bug is rich in nutrients.
After several hours of hard work, Zixu had one-tenth of his inner energy refined by the Poison Dart Frog, but he himself had mastered 50% of his body's inner energy. However, continuing on would be a waste of more than he gained, so Zixu Fei began to search inside the Poison Dart Frog's body, and finally found a way out.
There are two holes in the upper jaw of the poison dart frog. Although they are not big, and they are trying to close tightly, Zixu knows that this is his way to survive. At that moment, all the power he has accumulated, and then the purple-black inner energy suddenly explodes.
Although the source of the poison attribute internal energy was exactly the same and was assimilated very powerfully, it still managed to make a half-meter-large hole, and Zixu immediately flew out from there.
As for the Poison Dart Frog, which had been closing its eyes and concentrating, with this blow, a half-meter-large nostril was blown out of the outer nostril that was originally just a decoration. The Poison Dart Frog immediately screamed, and then turned towards the sky like crazy.Zixu chased after him.
The pain coming from the big hole in the upper jaw filled the poison dart frog's small brain with anger towards Zixu. It directly positioned it as the number one food and chased Zixu regardless. Even flying, which it originally couldn't do at all, by jumping crazily and continuously in the air, it could achieve a super-high speed no less than Zixu.
Zixu flew like crazy. His current state was not good. He was even close to the legendary ghost fairy. His body was a little transparent. As for attacking the poison dart frog, he couldn't do it now. His inner energy did almost zero damage to the poison dart frog.
If it were in the normal state, that attack would have shattered the poison dart frog into pieces, but now it only made a non-fatal hole, so it's better to run away!
Fortunately, since leaving the Central Plains, Zixu has accumulated a lot of experience in being hunted and has the common sense to deal with all kinds of being hunted. Therefore, Zixu successfully maintained the situation of being hunted and was not eaten by the poison dart frog.
As for escaping from the poison dart frog, who are you kidding? The poison dart frog's dynamic vision has already destined Zixu to have no hope of escaping.
No matter what methods Zixu used along the way, it was meaningless. Well, it was actually meaningful. The counter-pursuit experience that Zixu used along the way successfully brought the poison dart frog much closer to him. It is estimated that after a few more attempts, Zixu would be within the attack range of the poison dart frog's tongue.
So Zixu stopped trying to die and flew wildly north, from Antarctica to South America. Zixu flew all the way to North America before taking any rest, until Zixu saw a certain pyramid and the matter finally came to an end.
At that moment, Zixu was almost scared to death. When he flew over the pyramid, nothing happened, but when the poison dart frog flew over the pyramid, a super snake with a snake head and wings appeared. It was probably more than a thousand meters in size and dozens of meters in diameter, and then...
Well, there is no more. The super snake, with its mouth tens of meters wide when it opened, bit the flying croak in one bite. The poison dart frog desperately avoided most of the damage, and then exploded with poisonous blood and poison.
As for why Zixu, who was running away desperately, looked back and knew that the poison dart frog had escaped most of the damage, it was actually very simple. The feathered snake only bit half of it, and the poison dart frog managed to retain half of its body. Now this unlucky snake-eating frog has become half a frog...
However, Quetzalcoatl, or Quetzalcoatl, did not fare well either. The poisonous dart frog's poison was swallowed by Quetzalcoatl. The kilometer-long Quetzalcoatl was immediately paralyzed and its upper body was unstable and fell onto the pyramid, almost breaking its upper body. The injured poison dart frog saw that its perennial food dared to attack itself and almost lost half of its body. It immediately abandoned Zixu and bit the Quetzalcoatl.
Quetzalcoatl took one bite and ate the most unpalatable frog in many years. However, as a snake, even if it is Quetzalcoatl, even if it is upgraded to the level of Quetzalcoatl, it must be eaten as long as it is a frog. No matter whether it is poisonous or not, it must be eaten. Snakes must be the natural enemies of frogs!
